authority.error_scope: only the declared baseline vectors; not a universal bound

accepted_backend_modes.requirement: compute r_drag from a pinned CAMB authority at every required unique parameter vector
compute rs_drag from a pinned CLASS authority at every required unique parameter vector
build from pinned full-Boltzmann evaluations and predeclare domain, sampling design, interpolation method and held-out/direct-solver error criterion before using it in optimization

forbidden_modes: silent fallback to the current lightweight approximation
one baseline r_drag value reused for all variable parameter vectors
cache/interpolator without direct held-out solver validation
different r_drag backend/fairness policy across LCDM wCDM CPL and RLL within the same comparison cell

integration_interface.required_change: make the derived-r_d route explicitly backend-selectable and receipt-producing rather than implicitly bound to the lightweight approximation

required_preexecution_decisions: if cached: predeclare grid/domain/interpolator and held-out error threshold before optimization
declare behavior for RLL parameter vectors whose early/background mapping is not justified by the standard r_drag parameterization
freeze optimizer settings identical to the existing 24-cell convergence authority
required_outputs: unique parameter vectors evaluated by the full-Boltzmann authority or cache source
direct-vs-cache validation table if caching is used
cell-by-cell delta from the former lightweight approximation
explicit RLL mapping boundary and any rejected parameter regions
falsifiers: full-Boltzmann backend is not actually used by the formal derived-r_d route
cache error exceeds the predeclared threshold
one or more selected best fits fail the existing convergence policy
RLL early-time/baryon mapping is assumed without an explicit model contract
CLASS/CAMB disagreement exceeds the declared cross-engine acceptance policy
close_when: the formal derived-r_d route is backend-selectable and defaults are explicit
full-Boltzmann or validated-cache execution is evidenced
all 24 selected best fits pass unchanged convergence/fairness gates
approximation deltas and compute policy are persisted
RLL mapping assumptions are explicit rather than silently inherited
claim_boundary: This mechanism removes or measures the r_drag numerical approximation in the H0/r_d sensitivity path. It cannot substitute for RLL perturbation closure or an observational H0-tension claim.
